meta.name: competitor-scan
meta.description: Research best-in-class products using Browser MCP and WebSearch

copy.tagline: 调研竞品产品并生成洞察报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速了解竞品动态和行业最佳实践。
copy.tagline_en: Research competitor products and generate insights
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand competitor moves and industry best practices.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会通过浏览器截图和网页搜索，研究同类最佳产品（如 Notion、Slack、Stripe 等）的 UI 模式、交互流程和设计细节，并输出对比表格和设计洞察。
howto.when: 在设计项目初期、探索新 UI 模式或对标行业标准时，手动输入“use competitor-scan skill”触发。

say.text: 帮我扫描一下 Slack 的邀请流程。
say.note: Claude 会截图并分析 Slack 的邀请页面。

say.text: 对比 Notion 和 Linear 的布局设计。
say.note: 输出两个产品的布局模式对比表格。

say.text: 搜索 Airtable 的数据表格最佳实践。
say.note: 使用 WebSearch 查找 UI 拆解文章。

howto.what_en: Claude uses browser screenshots and web search to research best-in-class products (e.g., Notion, Slack, Stripe) for UI patterns, flows, and design details, producing comparison tables and insights.
howto.when_en: Triggered at the start of a DIVERGE loop, when exploring new UI patterns, or when benchmarking against industry standards by saying 'use competitor-scan skill'.

say_en.note: Claude will screenshot and analyze Slack's invitation page.

say_en.text: Compare Notion and Linear's layout design.
say_en.note: Outputs a comparison table of layout patterns.

say_en.text: Search for Airtable data table best practices.
say_en.note: Uses WebSearch to find UI teardown articles.
